fields.value: Neural network models and datasets of TUT age estimation demo (https://github.com/mahehu/TUT-live-age-estimator)

dsDescriptionValue.value: This repository contains the age, gender, smile and celebrity recognition neural networks and preprocessed datasets of our age estimation demo. This version uses neural network based alignment as opposed to the earlier version (10.5281/zenodo.3457689), which used the dlib implementation of "One Millisecond Face Alignment with an Ensemble of Regression Trees" by Vahid Kazemi and Josephine Sullivan (2014). The neural network regression improves both accuracy and speed.
